notes: OWNERSHIP NOT SOURCED. Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. SOURCING CAVEAT: www.sec.gov refused the research user agent, and GM's investor site (investor.gm.com, including its static-files PDFs) returned HTTP 403. The 10-K text was therefore read from a copy of GM's printed 2024 Annual Report (which wraps the Form 10-K, accession 0001467858-25-000032) hosted on pdf.dfcfw.com, a third-party filings mirror (East Money). This is not a primary host. Every cash and stock-comp value was confirmed exactly against SEC XBRL for that 10-K, but the URLs should be swapped for the EDGAR document (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785825000032/gm-20241231.htm) once it can be fetched. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' is $653 million, but it includes $123 million of 'Dividends to noncontrolling interests' (shown separately in the statement of equity). The common-shareholder figure, $530 million ('Cash dividends paid on common stock'), is recorded to match the parent-shareholder basis used for the other companies. BUYBACKS exclude the $101 million 'Issuance (redemption) of subsidiary stock' line. STOCK COMP: $332 million is the 10-K's stated total expense for stock incentive awards. XBRL also carries $543 million ('Stock based compensation' in the statement of equity, an APIC adjustment); that is not the expense and is not used. GEOGRAPHY: GM reports four rows, splitting Automotive and GM Financial into U.S. and Non-U.S.; they are copied as reported. The filing gives no combined U.S. / Non-U.S. revenue total. Ownership: the 2025 proxy (DEF 14A, accession 0001467858-25-000084, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785825000084/gm-20250422.htm) could not be fetched, so Mary Barra's stake and the 5% holders are not recorded. leader.status 'not-disclosed' is a placeholder meaning 'not sourced in this pass', NOT that the proxy omits her holding. largestHolders is null for the same reason. No broad employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K text reviewed, so plan is null.
